forge.instruction: Generate distinct candidates. Human-authored constraints are authoritative. For ROUTE_ENGINE obey Story Contract/Interface and close required dimensions. For ARCHITECTURE_PREFLIGHT write the readable story and character motives first, keep unresolved engineering details explicit, and show route identity, Ch2 reinterpretation, foreshadow potential, and active roles for the core cast. Background history may be invented when it earns present motives. Do not review.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer. Summarize what happened and why the main characters acted before judging pull, comprehension, emotional movement, and believable action. Do not reconstruct intent or repair.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit experience, knowledge, desire, action, consequence, motive continuity, and relationship-driven action for every consequential character. Distinguish unresolved architecture details from implausible motives. Cite evidence; do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit reread value, route truth difference, setup/payoff, and fairness. ROUTE_ENGINE also checks required mystery closure. ARCHITECTURE_PREFLIGHT judges reveal potential without demanding a finished evidence ledger. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit chronology, POV, knowledge, causality, information flow, and mechanism dependencies. Judge a rule by its actual story function rather than its label. In ARCHITECTURE_PREFLIGHT separate OPEN from CONTRADICTION. In ROUTE_ENGINE also run full closure checks. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD; do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: In ARCHITECTURE_PREFLIGHT rank readable story, motive, emotional movement, route identity, Ch2 reinterpretation, and foreshadow potential before completeness. Prefer NO_SELECTION over a mechanically neat but emotionally false synthesis. In ROUTE_ENGINE apply hard closure after story eligibility. Material synthesis changes require fresh review before promotion.
